what.text: This page follows Tibetan refugees in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 12581 Tibetan refugees.
Nepal hosts almost all of them, 99.7%; very small numbers live in France, Belgium and Australia.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for this group, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1964 to 1974.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1964 at 51000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 68000, at the end of 1974, and was lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
